faq.headline: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Get answers to common questions about our data services and how we can help your business.

whatServices.question: What data services does Cabana Data offer?
whatServices.answer: We offer end-to-end data solutions including Data Strategy & Consulting, Data Engineering & Architecture, Custom Application Development, and AI & Machine Learning Solutions. Our services are designed to help businesses at every stage of their data journey.

projectDuration.question: How long does a typical data engineering project take?
projectDuration.answer: Project timelines vary based on complexity and scope. A focused data pipeline project might take 4-8 weeks, while comprehensive data platform implementations can span several months. We work closely with clients to define realistic milestones and deliver value incrementally.

cloudPlatforms.question: Do you work with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, and Azure?
cloudPlatforms.answer: Yes, we have deep expertise across all major cloud platforms including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure. We help clients choose the right platform for their needs and implement cloud-native data solutions.

industries.question: What industries do you serve?
industries.answer: We work with businesses across various industries including technology, finance, healthcare, retail, and manufacturing. Our data solutions are tailored to meet the specific regulatory requirements and business challenges of each sector.

security.question: How do you ensure data security and compliance?
security.answer: Data security is fundamental to our approach. We implement industry best practices for data governance, encryption, access controls, and audit logging. We also help clients meet compliance requirements including GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, and other relevant regulations.

problem.headline: Uncertainty.
problem.description: Is Your Data Ready for AI? You're hearing about AI everywhere, but your data infrastructure is a tangled web of legacy systems and siloed information. You're unsure if you have the right foundation to capitalize on machine learning and risk being left behind.

decisions.title: Are You Making Decisions in the Dark?
decisions.description: Your teams lack access to reliable, real-time data, leading to missed opportunities and decisions based on gut feelings rather than facts. You have the data somewhere, but you can't get the right insights to the right people at the right time.

ideas.title: Are Your Digital Ideas Stuck on the Whiteboard?
ideas.description: You have a game-changing idea for a digital product or application, but you don't know if it's technically feasible, how to scope it, or what data it will require. The path from concept to a valuable, data-powered product is unclear.

discover.title: Discover & Align
discover.description: we start with in-depth workshops to understand your business goals, pain points, and existing data landscape.

analyze.title: Analyze & Diagnose
analyze.description: our experts conduct a thorough technical analysis of your systems, data quality, and architecture to identify key challenges and opportunities.

strategize.title: Strategize & Roadmap
strategize.description: we synthesize our findings into a strategic document, delivering a clear roadmap with prioritized initiatives, timelines, and estimated impact.

empower.title: Empower & Execute
empower.description: we present the final strategy to your stakeholders and provide the guidance needed for your team to execute the plan with confidence, or transition seamlessly to our implementation teams.

aiReadiness.title: AI Readiness Assessment
aiReadiness.whatIsIt: A comprehensive audit of your entire data ecosystem—from infrastructure and data quality to team skills—culminating in a prioritized roadmap of high-impact AI use cases.
aiReadiness.whoIsItFor: Companies committed to their AI journey who need a clear, strategic plan to ensure their foundation is solid and their investments will deliver ROI.

digitalFeasibility.title: Digital Product Feasibility
digitalFeasibility.whatIsIt: We validate your custom application idea by mapping core processes, defining data requirements, and creating a technical and product roadmap, ensuring your vision is achievable and set up for success.
digitalFeasibility.whoIsItFor: Businesses and entrepreneurs who want to build custom, data-driven applications and need to de-risk their investment with a solid technical and strategic plan.

dataHealthCheck.title: Data Health Check
dataHealthCheck.whatIsIt: A rapid diagnostic of your current data state, focusing on identifying immediate BigQuery optimization opportunities and data quality issues that hinder performance.
dataHealthCheck.whoIsItFor: Companies and teams that want a low-risk, high-value way to test the waters, understand their data landscape, and find quick wins.

designThinking.title: Design Thinking Workshop
designThinking.whatIsIt: A collaborative, hands-on session where we work with your team to frame problems, understand user needs, and ideate innovative solutions, aligning all stakeholders on a common vision.
designThinking.whoIsItFor: Organizations facing complex challenges or starting new projects that need to ensure their solution is user-centric, innovative, and solves the right problem from the start.

why.description1: Your most valuable insights are likely trapped right now inside the systems you use every day. Your ERP holds decades of operational history, your CRM contains every customer interaction, and your team is still investing time in manual reports.
why.description2: This data is the key to unlocking immense value, yet for many businesses, it remains a dormant asset—fragmented, inaccessible, and unused for critical decision-making. You have the raw materials, but not the factory to process them.
